scope: One fixed-order diagnostic input comparison in an isolated Windows 10 guest using deployed consumer applications

sourceBinding.plannedSourceCommitDomain: SDK candidate evidence commit; not the consumer product source commit
sourceBinding.consumerBuildMethod: Separate CMake input diagnostic with generated observation sources; no standard product build receipt is claimed
sourceBinding.x64Preservation: Use the preserved media/pe-trace executable and baseline-generated-x64 sources. Later trace-x64 zero-interval output is not used as this baseline.

payloadBinding.limitation: The ISO and deployment file hashes plus observed launch from each selected directory bind the inputs. The trace does not independently record loaded module paths or hashes.

originalGuestSerialInterval.label: external/guest-serial.log
originalGuestSerialInterval.note: The guest serial file continues growing. The frozen prefix and exact extracted interval are bound; this is not a hash of its later full contents.

offsetConventions.sourceSerialAppendByteOffset: Zero-based offset within the growing original guest serial file, using the frozen prefix boundary

metricDefinitions.queue: queued to dispatch on the engine; starts after SDK submission
metricDefinitions.dispatch: dispatch to dispatched; includes dispatch guards and any synchronous input call
metricDefinitions.mouse: fire to fired around wkeFireMouseEvent; no success return or visual completion is inferred
metricDefinitions.nativeCallback: native_begin to native_end around DispatchMessageW; all recorded native callbacks here are message 275 (WM_TIMER)
metricDefinitions.percentiles: Nearest-rank summaries of this small recorded sample only; not stable population estimates

results.note: Paint callbacks are not attributed to inputs; mouseApiReached does not prove an action succeeded.

observedComparison.interpretation: The recorded move queue maxima are lower in the candidate runs. Cooperative 2 ms scheduler batching does not cap an individual callback or establish full input-to-display latency.

guiObservations.source: Operator observation reported by the parent task, supplemented by the bound screenshots and actions log
guiObservations.mainActions: Device refresh; usage guide; notebook; branded desktop; step 2; UEFI image; Esc; return; normal close confirmation
guiObservations.peActions: Seven safe clicks were repeated in the old and new PE application directories
guiObservations.limitation: The actions log records main-new startup only; its later action effectiveness and normal close are operator observations, not extra entries inferred from that log.

incompletePacket.explanation: The dispatch wrapper completed without a recorded mouse call. The trace schema has no target, generation, modifiers or guard reason. Its exact cause and any relationship to closing are not proven; coordinates do not identify a close button.

closeEvidence.condition: const bool closed = !host_ || host_->destroy().ok; if (closed) rk_input_trace::flush();
closeEvidence.scope: A complete export supports that the diagnostic close condition was satisfied. An already absent or closed host may also satisfy it.

dispatchGuards.scope: Context, input permission, cursor permission, view or interaction-generation guards may return before fire; actual branch is not recorded.

limitations: One short diagnostic run in fixed PE-old, PE-new, main-old, main-new order; small samples, no randomized or repeated performance experiment.
Startup is included and session lengths differ; full-session event, packet, paint and callback totals are not throughput comparisons.
The independent PE application ran under Windows 10, not a WinPE boot.
No optical input/display timing, physical presentation measurement or native-renderer baseline was performed.
Paint callbacks are not attributed to individual inputs, and mouseApiReached does not prove that an action succeeded.
The final main-new move packet is incomplete at the mouse interface and remains explicitly reported.
These consumer launches used no owned Job launcher. GUI close observation and complete trace export do not establish root-process natural exit, an exit code, or an empty Job.
This record does not expand SDK production qualification or release readiness.
